title: CodeChef: Hoop Jump
description: You and your friend are jumping through `n` hoops (n is odd) from opposite ends (you from 1, friend from n). Both jump 1 step at a time. The game ends when both reach the same hoop. Which hoop is that?
constraints:
1 <= n <= 10^5, n is odd
• Time: O(1) | Space: O(1)
explanation: Midpoint of odd sequence [1, n] is (n // 2) + 1 in O(1) time.
